summary: Iteration 9: retested Clerk sign-up, sign-in, Google and email after the Protect rules were turned off. All requested checks pass. (1) UI sign-up at /sign-up with qa.signup.nns7fu+clerk_test@example.com and a 22-char password went straight to /sign-up/verify-email-address, with no protect-check page. Code 424242 signed the user in and redirected to /. The header showed the UserButton, the session survived a refresh, and /siparislerim loaded the empty state. (2) Admin password sign-in (admin+clerk_test@lumapetshop.com.tr) works. On a new browser Clerk adds a /sign-in/client-trust new-device step, and code 424242 passes it. After sign-in the header shows Yönetici, and /api/me returns 200 role=admin with a Bearer getToken(). /api/me returns 401 without a token. Sign-out brings back the signed-out header. (3) The Google button on /sign-in redirects to accounts.google.com/v3/signin with no Clerk error. (4) The emails.send_email command returned id 01a18f6d-3cb6-7056-bdfd-e3914b5f07db with no 'Resend send failed' warning (1 email sent, to info@lumapetshop.com.tr). Regression: test_iteration8_own_clerk.py passed 21/21.

issues: The subtitle still reads 'My Application ile devam etmek için'. Rename the application to 'Luma Petshop' in the Clerk Dashboard (carried over from iteration 8).

Info: password sign-in on a new device triggers Clerk client-trust (email code). This is expected Clerk behaviour; real users get a code by email. Turn it off in the Clerk dashboard if it is not wanted.
critical_code_review_comments: emails.send_email: Resend is primary and Emergent is the fallback. Logic is fine. On a fallback, the Resend error is logged only as a warning.
